name: Air
description: Air understands your brand, organizes your library, and scales creative while keeping humans involved where they matter most.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Air to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Air to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.air.inc/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Air MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Air lists 24 MCP tools, including add_asset_to_board, add_tag_to_asset, create_board, create_import, create_tag, get_asset, get_asset_boards, get_asset_download_url, get_asset_image, get_board, get_custom_field, and get_import_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Air?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Air in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Air requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Air is developed by Air Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
